name: Source Account

Executes on the scheduled date (e.g., 15th of month) during early morning hours before business hours, with funds transferred via Faster Payments Service (FPS) to the recipient account within 1 hour. name: Standing Order

description: End-to-end procedure for detecting, alerting, retrying, and resolving failed standing order payment attempts. The process includes automated system detection, customer notification, retry logic, escalation to staff review, and final resolution through customer action or cancellation.
